{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fitted charcoal wool-blend blazer is not needed here as a separate layer choice, so the outer layer is a coat: see the last garment line.

Fine-knit merino turtleneck, slim cut, hip length, ivory (#F2EBDD), merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool flannel
Textured tweed blazer, tailored single-breasted, hip length, grey-brown (#6E6259), wool blend
Tailored overcoat, single-breasted, knee length, camel (#B58B5A), wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, black (#1C1C1C), smooth leather with a grip sole
Wool scarf, large and soft, deep burgundy (#6B2433), brushed wool
Leather gloves, lined, wrist length, black (#1C1C1C), soft leather
Structured tote bag, medium size, black (#1C1C1C), grained leather

This outfit keeps the neat business look the office asks for, with a turtleneck, trousers and a textured blazer in calm, muted tones. The layers of fine merino, flannel, tweed and a wool-cashmere overcoat hold the warmth you need for a frosty walk to work, and the scarf and gloves protect the neck and hands. The block-heel boots with a grip sole keep your steps steady on cold, possibly slippery pavement. The camel coat and burgundy scarf add colour to the neutral base, and the tote carries your work things neatly."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2151,"output_tokens":518},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
